summary.name: GitLab FOSS
summary.one_liner: GitLab FOSS is a read-only mirror of the GitLab codebase with all proprietary code removed, no longer the place where development happens.
use_cases: Browse the GitLab Community Edition source code
Find the archived open source GitLab codebase
summary.what_it_does: ["This GitLab.com project is a read-only mirror of GitLab with proprietary code removed. It previously hosted GitLab Community Edition. According to the page, all development has moved to the main gitlab-org/gitlab project. The page shows repository stats of 118,494 commits, 4,558 branches, 2,053 tags and 5 environments, with an MIT License and files such as CHANGELOG and CONTRIBUTING. The listing on awesome-selfhosted describes GitLab as self-hosted Git repository management with code reviews, issue tracking, activity feeds and wikis, with Ruby, deb, Docker and K8S packaging noted."]
notable: Read-only mirror with proprietary code removed
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under project management
caveats: Read-only mirror; no active development happens here
Previously hosted GitLab Community Edition; development has moved to gitlab-org/gitlab
